# City Center Residences

> City Center Residences is a 52-storey residential tower in Downtown Dubai, marketed under the W Hotels brand as W Residences Dubai - Downtown, with Marriott International managing its services. It holds around 384 one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments of roughly 65 to 137 square metres, looking onto Burj Khalifa, the Dubai Fountain and Dubai Opera. Amenities include a podium infinity pool and terrace, a spa, a wellness and fitness centre and a residents' cinema.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Downtown Dubai, UAE
- Status: On-Going

## MENASCO Scope

City Center Residences is a residential development by Dar Al Arkan in the Burj Khalifa district of Downtown Dubai, with LACASA Architects & Engineering Consultants as consultant. MENASCO was appointed to deliver the MEP works for the project, adding to its portfolio of residential developments in Dubai's central districts.
